description: Starts rendering the whole music video for a quote from quote_mv_render: character images, scene images, scene videos and the final cut, continuing automatically in the background (usually 20–60 minutes). Spends credits from the user's MusVideo account: before calling, tell the user the cost and get explicit confirmation in the chat. The amount is the quote's totalCredits, charged stage by stage; failed items are refunded. Retrying with the same quoteId returns the same render and never charges twice.

projectId.description: MusVideo project id returned by create_mv_project or list_my_videos.

name: start_mv_render
title: Start rendering the video
